## What's new

Threadnote 5.1.0-beta.2 makes resumed Context Briefs start from the source cited by the selected handoff, keeping follow-up work grounded in the code that matters.

### Ground resumed work in cited source

- When a handoff includes code citations, a resumed Context Brief carries those paths or symbols into its graph evidence automatically.
- Cited source is prioritized over incidental task-text matches, so agents can continue a handoff with more relevant code context and fewer repeated searches.
